document.about: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Report, June 2025. Each part of a section opens on its finding in bold, a line or two over its prose: `Inflation remained above 2 percent` and, on two lines, `Most measures of longer-term inflation expectations have been stable, while …`.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#403): a finding longer than twelve words was no heading, its shorter siblings in the same style were: only type set at 1.5 times the body may run longer.

checks.issue: #403: the two-line finding was a paragraph.

section.title: Most measures of longer-term inflation expectations have been stable, while shorter-term inflation expectations have risen sharply
